description: This file defines the SugarAutoLoader class responsible for dynamically loading class files and managing class-to-file mappings in the SuiteCRM system. It contains autoload logic, mapping arrays, and methods to resolve class filenames based on naming conventions, module context, and customizations.

classes.name: SugarAutoLoader
classes.description: A class that manages dynamic autoloading of classes, including handling module-specific, view, and widget classes, with support for custom paths.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Main autoload method that resolves and includes the PHP file for a given class name.

methods.name: getFilenameForViewClass
methods.description: Resolves the filename for view classes, considering module context and custom overrides.

methods.name: getFilenameForSugarWidget
methods.description: Resolves the filename for SugarWidget classes, supporting customization.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Preloads all classes defined in the static maps and global $beanFiles.
